title: AI latency versus traffic mix
prompt: Median AI inference latency rose 55% after model version 4.2 was deployed. Determine why.
facts: Version 4.2 launched to all requests on day 5.
Long-document traffic rose from 9% to 31% of requests during days 1-6.
Within each document-length bucket, latency changed less than 4% before versus after 4.2.
GPU utilization rose in proportion to long-document share.
